description_en: Creates a new traffic control task with multiple conditions and target configurations
description_zh: 用于创建新的流量调控任务，支持多种条件设置和目标配置
kebab_example: aliyun pairecservice create-traffic-control-task --name task-1 --description this_is_a_test_task --scene-id 1 --execution-time TimeRange --start-time 2024-03-25 --end-time 2024-03-26 --behavior-table-meta-id 1 --user-table-meta-id 2 --item-table-meta-id 3 --user-condition-type Array --user-condition-array field_:_gender_,_option_:_=_,_value_:_male --user-condition-express age_=30_3_=level_=6_gender=male --statis-behavior-condition-type Array --statis-behavior-condition-array field_:_click_,_option_:_=_,_value_:_30 --statis-behavior-condition-express click=30 --control-type Percent --control-granularity Global --control-logic Guaranteed --item-condition-type Array --item-condition-express status=1 --traffic-control-targets Status=Opened EndTime=2024-04-25 RecallName=recall_1 StartTime=2024-03-25 ItemConditionExpress=status=1 Name=target_1 ItemConditionArray=field_:_status_,_option_:_=_,_value_:_1 ItemConditionType=Array ToleranceValue=20 NewProductRegulation=false Value=100.0 Event=click StatisPeriod=Daily --instance-id pairec-cn-000test --item-condition-array field_:_status_,_option_:_=_,_value_:_1 --service-id 1 --pre-experiment-ids 1,2,3 --prod-experiment-ids 4,5,6 --flink-resource-id res-000 --effective-scene-ids 3 --service-ids 3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTrafficControlTask

parameters.help_en: The behavior table ID
parameters.help_zh: 行为表表ID
parameters.name: behavior_table_meta_id

parameters.help_en: The control granularity. Valid values: Global (applies globally) and Single (applies to a specific item)
parameters.help_zh:
调控粒度。
Global：全局。
Single：单品
parameters.name: control_granularity

parameters.help_en:
The control logic.

Guaranteed: The system strictly enforces the control target.

Approach: The system attempts to meet the control target, but enforcement is not strict
parameters.help_zh:
调控逻辑。

Guaranteed：保量。

Approach：逼近
parameters.name: control_logic

parameters.help_en:
The control type.

Percent: Controls traffic by percentage.

Quantity: Controls traffic by quantity
parameters.help_zh:
调控类型。

Percent：按比例调控。

Quantity：按数量调控
parameters.name: control_type

parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The execution time.

Permanent: The task runs permanently.

parameters.help_zh:

Permanent：永久执行。
